text:
Avery: Quick sync — given the infra regression last week I want to propose a fractional MVP approach rather than trying to cram everything into the original v1 date. Shipable slice = core inference API + read-only tenant UI, move admin console / bulky analytics to v1.

Jamie: Sounds reasonable. Two questions: can core API meet latency targets without embeddings cache and without the admin telemetry hooks?

Sai: Proposal criteria: 1) pilot customers can onboard in under 1 day; 2) 99th p token latency <= 350ms for 95% of traffic; 3) model pinning & canary routing available. If any criteria fail, hold GA.

Maria: Rough ENG estimates: core API + routing 10 dev-days, read-only UI 4 dev-days, admin console 12 dev-days. If we cut admin we save ~2 sprints of QA time.

Avery: Timelines I'm thinking: org pilot in ~3 weeks (fractional MVP), GA in 8 weeks with admin. If infra recovery stalls, push GA +2 weeks and run extended pilot.

Jamie: If we cut admin from MVP we should provide an "operator API" fallback so SREs can do tenant-level ops. Lightweight: GET/POST endpoints, no UI. I can prototype that by EOD Friday.

Sai: Important for product: we need a customer-facing launch checklist that calls out limitations (no admin UI, limited analytics) so expectations are clear. I'll draft the comms and the acceptance criteria doc.

Maria: +1 on operator API fallback. Also recommend a temporary telemetry flag so we can toggle detailed traces for pilot customers only. Minimizes perf cost.

DeployBot: Reminder: scheduled release freeze in 48h for the next window — coordinate any hot changes ASAP :warning:

Jamie: Acknowledged. I'll push the prototype branch behind a feature flag and add a short README for procedures.

Sai: Action items summarized: Jamie -> operator-API prototype (EOD Fri); Maria -> update eng estimates and QA plan; Avery -> update milestone tracker & customer pilot invite; Sai -> launch checklist + comms.

Avery: If there are no objections by EOD, we'll adopt the fractional MVP and rebaseline the milestone dates. Please react with :thumbsup: if you approve.

Jamie: :thumbsup:

Maria: :thumbsup:

Sai: :thumbsup:

Avery: Thanks — will update the roadmap doc and ping stakeholders.
